id: title:Z3r0Sum:revert tags stop writing the legacy tagged item keys

review.posthog_relevance: Database schema migration and compatibility for the TaggedItem model, supporting the replacement of legacy polymorphic foreign keys with explicit per-model columns and a generic pointer.
review.reason: The supplied hunks demonstrate a database migration and model compatibility change. P1.F5.H3 and P1.F5.H4 add ForeignKey relationships and unique constraints to support storing explicit references to Dashboard, Insight, and other models, while P1.F5.H7 implements the migration compatibility and cleanup logic to populate generic pointers from legacy columns. review.uncertainty: The chunk lacks the implementation of helper functions and the migration that adds the database constraints, and P1.F9 and P1.F15 are dominated by tests without production implementation, so the tier is assigned based on the available model and compatibility changes rather than the complete migration or helper implementation.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the implementation of the helper functions `build_partial_uniqueness_constraint` and `build_unique_relationship_check` referenced in P1.F5.H5, nor the implementation of the new `sync_foreign_keys` method referenced in P1.F5.H2. It also does not include the migration that actually adds the database constraints, only the migration that removes legacy ones.

observations.behavior: Adds a ForeignKey to Dashboard, Insight, EventDefinition, PropertyDefinition, Action, FeatureFlag, ExperimentSavedMetric, Ticket, Account, Endpoint, ReplayScanner, Project, and Experiment to TaggedItem.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows TaggedItem to store a direct reference to Dashboard, Insight, etc., rather than relying solely on the generic content_type/object_id. This supports the migration strategy of replacing legacy per-model foreign keys with a single generic pointer while retaining the ability to store the relationship explicitly.

observations.behavior: Adds ForeignKey to Project and Experiment with db_constraint=False.
observations.posthog_connection: These fields are read on nearly every request; adding a database constraint inline would lock the table. This allows the migration to proceed without holding a long lock, with the constraint added and validated separately later.

observations.behavior: Adds unique_together constraint on tag and each related object field.
observations.posthog_connection: Ensures a tag cannot be assigned to the same Dashboard, Insight, etc., twice. This maintains referential integrity and prevents duplicate associations.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs are present. No tier assignment is performed.

observations.behavior: Replacement of the generic polymorphic foreign key pattern with explicit per-model columns and a generic pointer, including migration compatibility and tests.
observations.posthog_connection: This hunk changes the tagged item model to support storing the same tagged object in either a legacy per-model column or a generic polymorphic pointer, while retaining compatibility with existing rows.
